page.layout: One page of text, one column, with a woodcut ornament above the heading and a large woodcut initial at the start of the first paragraph; no margin notes. Signature "A 2" at the foot right of centre.

main_text.head: ORNATISSIMO VIRO, DOM. RICHARDO TOMSON ANGLO SVO, IACOBVS CHRISTMANNVS S.
main_text.p: QVAESTIO elegans est & necessaria, Richarde doctissime, quo anno, & quo mense, diéue, Christus seruator noster passus fuerit: ex hac enim diligenter declarata a refutari possunt errores, qui non modo propter contemtum syncera antiquitatis, verum etiam propter depravatam temporum multorum collationem orti fuerunt. Vt autem proposita quaestio ex certis historiarum monumentis stabiliatur, & secundum veritatis normam decidatur, in primis animadvertendum est, quid nobis antiquitas de anno passionis Dominicae scriptum reliquerit, & qua ratione characteres assignati inter se conveniant: nam accepimus Dominum nostrum passum esse anno XVIIII imperii Tiberii, concurrente anno quarto Olympiadis CCII, & ineunte anno XXXIIII ab incarnatione. A quibus temporum indicibus ego nullo modo deflectendum

page.notes: The Roman numerals in the text are set in spaced italic and were read as printed ("XVIIII", "XXXIIII" as far as legible); the initial letter "Q" is a woodcut initial joined to "VAESTIO". Passage is in italic throughout; the heading is roman capitals.
